preReg.batch: CS pipeline shape-gate repair (pre-registered 2026-09-04, before the v3 run)
preReg.basis: tools/data/cs-diagnosis-report.json (A1-A3 short-band decomposition, B1-B3 long-band attribution) — measurement first, repair second

scoringChange.from: mixture MS-CS mean: one target spectrum for all realizations
scoringChange.to: per-realization bin-conditional Baker conditional spectrum — each realization scored against its OWN deaggregation bin conditional mean muC_b(T) (muC_b(T*) = log imTarget exactly); the ensemble is probability-weighted through bin sampling
scoringChange.justification: diagnosis A3: the MS-CS mixture ratio at 0.1 s sits below EVERY contributing bin zhao median ratio in 4/6 cases (osaka RP2500 -0.424 vs envelope [-0.140..-0.007]; kochi RP2500 -0.119 vs [0.191..0.290]) — anchor-scaled single-event realizations cannot realize the between-period residual structure the mixture mean encodes, so the mixture gate is structurally unfalsifiable; multi-scenario bin-conditional comparison is the standard practice (Lin & Baker 2013 family)
scoringChange.mixtureKeptAs: diagnostic column (bandsMixture + perCase.biasMixtureLog10) — no gate reads it
scoringChange.gatesUnchanged: all v2 gate thresholds and definitions carry over unchanged

hfReCalibration.kappaNote: hybrid module default (pre-B2-fit value); B2 froze 0.02 against its absolute PGA/PGV objective — NOT re-fitted to CS targets; the diagnosis measured -0.186 median short-band effect
hfReCalibration.stressObjective: per source class, minimize the mass-weighted median |bin-conditional bias| over 0.1-0.5 s across contributing bins (prob >= 0.005) of the six frozen cases, kappa pinned 0.04, 5 seeds per bin
hfReCalibration.circularityDisclosure: the stress fit uses the same zhao conditional spectra the gates read — after this calibration the 0.1-0.5 s band tests fit-consistency and scatter, NOT independent falsification of zhao at short periods; the B2 frozen calibration (50 MPa class-blind, kappa 0.02) stays untouched for the B2 scorecard product

lfEmpiricalGain.form: g(T)=1 for T<=1s; log10 g(T) = (b0 + b1*(mw-8) + b2*log10(rRup/50)) * min(1, ln(T)/ln(3)) for T>1s, capped to [1,10]
lfEmpiricalGain.fit: least squares over per-bin long-period deficits (T in {1.5,2,3,4,5}s, contributing bins) of the DW-side spectral ratio vs the bin-conditional zhao ratio, at the calibrated stress; frozen to tools/data/cs-repair-calibration.json
lfEmpiricalGain.circularityDisclosure: after the gain the 2-5 s band tests gain-consistency (smoothness, between-bin generalization), not independent falsification of the 1D kernel; the lpImprovement-vs-Brune gate stays meaningful — the brune comparator arm receives NO gain (it has no DW side)

stressDecision: KEEP the B2 frozen 50 MPa (class-blind): the frozen-grid scan is FLAT within noise (crustal 0.4415->0.429, interplate 0.4042->0.4001, intraslab 0.3015->0.2984 over 50->6 MPa) — for the deaggregation bins (M>=7.6) the whole 1-10 Hz band sits above the Brune corner on the omega^-2 tail, so stress moves the LEVEL but not the anchor-normalized SHAPE and the 1 s scaling absorbs it completely. Re-calibrating stress on this flat scan would be an arbitrary fit of noise (measured negative result, 2026-09-04).
lfGainDecision: REFUTED by residual structure (2026-09-04): the fitted (mw,rRup) gain under-corrects kochi (needs ~10^0.55 at 2-4 s, got 10^0.37) and OVER-corrects osaka (+0.54/+0.78 at 4-5 s with the gain vs ~-0.1..-0.3 pre-gain bin-conditional deficit). kochi RP475 (M8.79@26km) and osaka RP475 (M8.71@42km) sit at nearly identical (mw,rRup) yet carry opposite-signed 2-4 s residuals -> the DW long-period deficit is SITE/BASIN-specific, not a source (mw,rRup) property, so the pre-registered functional form cannot separate them. Gain application disabled; fitted coefficients retained above as the refutation measurement. Repairing this properly needs P-SV/3D basin response (registered, out of scope).
